_comment: DOUBLER COMBAT PAY (iii) -- the board after combat (MTG_DOUBLER_COMBAT_PAY; Morph INT-16). Turn 3: a face-down
Blistering Firecat attacks alone past a sick Ignoble Hierarch; Gruul Turf x2 and a Forest untapped; Den Protector,
Berserk, Birds of Paradise in hand. Main 1: Den Protector face down ({3}), then Berserk on the Firecat; main 2: Birds.
Main alone pays {3} + {G} off the two Turfs and leaves the Forest up. But Berserk is credited as cast in combat
((2 + 1) x 2 = 6), and then the {3} cannot use the Turfs' fourth unit (it empties with main), so all three lands
are tapped and Birds cannot be cast in main 2. The old probe credited the combat cast and kept main's taps: the
Forest stayed up and paid for Birds. MTG_DOUBLER_COMBAT_PAY=0 realises [Den Protector, Berserk, Birds].
